newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Century Drilling rejects Downer bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Century Drilling rejects Downer bid.

text.p: Australian drilling contractor Century Drilling Ltd said the A$1.02 a share takeover bid launched last week by a subsidiary of Hong Kong-based Paul Y-Construction Holdings Ltd was opportunistic and grossly undervalued the company.
The Paul Y unit, Downer Group Australia Pty Ltd, said last Friday it had lodged a formal Part A takeover statement to acquire Century Drilling.
The bid values Century's issued capital of 46.66 million ordinary shares and 7.71 million convertible notes at A$55.46 million.
Century shares had already climbed six cents to A$1.09 on Friday before the bid was unveiled and have traded well above the offer price since then.
They climbed to a 1996 high of A$1.16 in shortened pre-holiday trading on Tuesday and closed three cents higher on the day at A$1.13.
